Definition: Jehoseph (i.e. Joseph), a son of Jacob
BiblicalUsage: Jehoseph is Joseph, the son of Jacob, named in the psalm that remembers the Exodus. In Psalms 81:5, This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Joseph matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
